title: The Goldspire Relay
kicker: A twisting stone signal-spire of mirrors, flags, and courier-birds, its beacon flickering thinner than it should.
hook: A twisting stone signal-spire of mirrors, flags, and courier-birds, its beacon flickering thinner than it should.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Goldspire Relay twists upward like maintenance became monument, its weak fire making future failure visible.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: A stone spire that twists upward as if maintenance kept turning into monument. The signal yard flashes with mirrors, flags, and courier-birds. The beacon chamber flickers with meaning. From the ridge overlook you can see every place you have been at once...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place courier birds, ridge insects, tiny cliff goats that ignore danger No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade, or route interests Food, tools, route signs, local goods, or...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Signal crews eat in shifts at the yard, one hand always free for a flag, bread and hard cheese and a tea brewed strong enough to survive the wind. The courier-birds get the scraps and the affection both.
